title: Ask can make a photo as well as an illustration
goal: When a person asks Ask for a photo or anything photographic (a photo of a golden retriever on a beach, a realistic coffee cup, a product shot, a background photo), it makes a real photographic picture and puts it in the document as a picture layer. When they ask for an illustration, icon or drawing it keeps making editable vector layers as today. The person can also say which they want, and the result can be made again or turned into the other kind.
notes:
The user, 2026-10-24: 'i see we have zimage but it's not seemingly able to generate photos - only illustrations with vector art. I'd like to be able to be able to do both.'

Cause, from reading the code (not reproduced in the app): Z-Image Turbo is used only as a step on the way to vector. Every add_drawing goes to the picture model with a forced flat look (Scripts/picture-model/server.py:31 LOOK 'flat vector illustration... a few flat colours', :55 ICON, :59 SCENE; prompt_for at :65) and the result is always traced into paths (Scripts/picture-model/layers.py, vtracer). There is no route that keeps the painted pixels. Design write-up: docs/design/ask.md:226-366 ('Painting a drawing', 'The picture model'). Swift side: Sources/Photonz/Agent/AskPictureModel.swift, Sources/PhotonzCore/AskPictureModelPlan.swift, PictureModelRequest in Sources/PhotonzCore/AgentDrawingPlacement.swift.

Likely shape: a new agent command (e.g. add_photo) or a 'photo' kind on the request, a server endpoint that returns the PNG without tracing and with a photographic prompt, and an image layer added via the ImageStore through History.perform. Z-Image Turbo is good at photoreal; check resolution limits and memory beside the 29 GB planning model (ask.md:355-358). Memory rule: no hardcoded subjects or stored content, quality via model, prompt and general techniques (see memory no-hardcoded-generated-content). The ask-eval set lives under Scripts/ask-eval; queue/tasks/p1-high/the-ask-test-set-scores-video-requests-too.json is a precedent for extending it.
acceptance: Asking 'a photo of a dog on a beach', 'a realistic red apple on a wooden table' or 'a product shot of headphones' at Next defaults puts in a photographic picture layer, not traced vector shapes; asking 'draw a dog', 'an icon of a dog' or 'an illustration of a dog' still makes vector layers

How the request is read (photo or illustration) comes from the planning model reading the request and general words, never from a stored list of subjects; a request that says neither picks sensibly and the result says which it made

The photo is painted at the document's size and aspect (or the selection's, or a sensible default in an empty window), at full picture model quality with no flat-look words in its prompt, and placed as one undo step through the same command the agent uses (MCP), so the agent can make photos too
The photo layer is an ordinary picture layer: effects, crop, masking, the existing edit tools all work on it; pixels live in the image store, not the document model

A visual bar today's path fails: the Ask test set gains photo requests, scored by the model judge for 'looks like a real photograph' and 'did what was asked'; today's output for those requests (traced flat shapes) is scored first as the baseline and the new path must clearly beat it; numbers in the audit
Time and memory per photo MEASURED on this Mac and written in the audit beside the illustration path's
Try path: open an empty window at Next defaults, press Command K, ask for a photo of a dog on a beach; then ask for an illustration of a dog

Audit under queue/audits/ with a contact sheet of photo and illustration results for the same subjects; anything left rough is filed as a follow-up task if it clears the follow-up bar (queue/bin/follow-up-bar.md), and written into this task's log if it does not
